description: Prebuilt IRS/FTB reference corpus (FTS5 + voyage-law-2 embeddings) + forms catalog. 10 docs / 527 blocks, tax year 2025.
_notes: url points at a GitHub Release asset (corpus-v1 tag) once the repo is public. Empty url → corpus:fetch falls back to CORPUS_SEED_PATH or an existing .data/corpus.db. Everyone downloads the full corpus; per-state packs are a future option if size demands it.
